page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.4xlarge is an instance within the Local SSDs family, running on the KVM hypervisor with x86_64 architecture. Compute is delivered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz across 16 dedicated vCPUs. System memory is sized at 64.0 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The server does not include GPU acceleration.

A defining characteristic of this instance is the inclusion of 893 GB of bundled local SSD storage. Because this storage resides locally on the physical host, it bypasses network-attached storage latency. Baseline network bandwidth is provisioned at 3 Gbps. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned by default.

By coupling dedicated processor resources and balanced RAM with integrated local solid-state storage, this hardware profile avoids the performance and cost overhead of external block volumes for temporary or replicated data tiers. The configuration is suited for transactional databases, NoSQL stores, search indexing engines, and data caching nodes requiring fast local disk access.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.4xlarge is an instance from the Local SSDs family built on x86_64 architecture and managed by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, providing 16 dedicated vCPUs paired with 64.0 GB of system memory for an even 4.0 GB per core allocation. Designed for I/O-sensitive operations, the configuration includes 893 GB of bundled local SSD storage to reduce disk access latency, complemented by a 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The system contains no discrete GPUs. With its balanced processor-to-memory configuration and built-in local solid-state storage, ecs.i1.4xlarge is structured for workloads that require reliable local disk throughput alongside dedicated compute capacity, including relational database engines, NoSQL clusters, log indexing pipelines, and medium-scale caching applications.
